actors.title: Google Autocomplete Keyword Research Tool
actors.description: A multi-depth scraper that harvests Google Autocomplete suggestions from any seed keyword. Expand a single topic into hundreds of long-tail keyword ideas by traversing the full alphabet and recursively following the most relevant suggestions.

actors.title: Linkedin Ad Library Scraper
actors.description: Scrape and analyze paid advertising campaigns from the LinkedIn Ad Library — extract headlines, body copy, images, videos, CTAs, targeting details, impressions, and advertiser information across multiple countries.

actors.title: Mercado Livre Scraper
actors.description: Automate product research on Mercado Livre — Brazil's largest e-commerce marketplace. Scrape product names, prices, discounts, seller info, ratings, free shipping status, and more from search results in structured, analysis-ready JSON.

actors.title: User Interviews Scraper
actors.description: The User Interviews Scraper is a powerful tool designed to extract valuable information about user research studies hosted on UserInterviews.com.

actors.title: Exploding Topics - Top Websites Scraper
actors.description: Scrape trending and “exploding” websites from Exploding Topics, categorized by industry and region, to uncover emerging market trends.

actors.title: Similarweb Scraper
actors.description: Extract comprehensive SimilarWeb analytics data for any domain — including traffic, rankings, competitors, audience demographics, referral sources, and technology stack — in structured  format.

actors.title: Tennis Abstract Scraper
actors.description: Extract complete tennis player data from TennisAbstract.com: career match history, per-match statistics (aces, hold %, break %, dominance ratio), tour-level and challenger seasonal summaries, and year-end Elo rankings — delivered as clean JSON on Apify.

actors.title: Vercel Domain Scraper
actors.description: Check domain availability and pricing on Vercel for any brand name, across the TLDs you choose.

actors.title: B3 - Boletim Diário - Negócios Consolidados do Pregão
actors.description: Extraia os dados de Negócios Consolidados do Pregão de bolsa publicados no Boletim Diário da B3. Obtenha dados estruturados sobre preços, volumes, ofertas e ajustes de ações, opções e futuros negociados.

actors.title: B3 - Boletim Diário - Participação dos Investidores
actors.description: Extraia os dados de Participação dos Investidores do Boletim Diário da B3 publicados no Boletim Diário da B3. Obtenha dados estruturados sobre a contribuição de cada perfil de investidor no volume total de negociações da bolsa.

actors.title: B3 - Boletim Diário - Derivativos - Posições em Aberto
actors.description: Extraia os dados de Posições em Aberto de derivativos de bolsa publicados no Boletim Diário da B3. Obtenha dados estruturados sobre opções, open interest, distribuição de posições entre tomadores e doadores, e muito mais.
